case: Boone v. Unsatisfied Claim and Judgment Fund
issue: Whether a rideshare (TNC) liability policy must provide PIP to an uninsured pedestrian struck by a Lyft driver
holding_plain_english: Yes; N.J.S.A. 17:28-1.3 requires PIP for pedestrians on every non-private motor vehicle liability policy; Lyft's Liberty Mutual policy reformed to include it

case: Allstate NJ v. Carteret Comprehensive Medical Care
issue: Whether insurer fraud and RICO claims against a medical provider must go to PIP arbitration
holding_plain_english: No; Fraud Act and RICO claims are not subject to AICRA PIP arbitration; complaint reinstated with jury right

issue: Whether deductible and copayment erode a 15,000 PIP limit
holding_plain_english: Insurer must pay the full 15,000 of benefits; deductible and copayment are the insured's obligations on top and do not reduce the limit

issue: Whether the DWI bar on all claims applies without a conviction or guilty plea (breath test refused)
holding_plain_english: No; N.J.S.A. 39:6A-4.5(b) requires a conviction or guilty plea; summary judgment for defendants properly denied

issue: Uninsured-owner bar where owner was killed retrieving a phone from his disabled car in a second crash
holding_plain_english: Bar applies only while operating the uninsured car; not operating, so claims proceed

case: Palisades Insurance v. Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield
issue: Whether a PIP carrier that paid bills out of turn can subrogate against the health-primary insurer
holding_plain_english: No statutory subrogation right; recover from providers or by assignment

issue: Mid-trial involuntary dismissal of a rear-end permanency case after a dispute over which doctors would testify
holding_plain_english: Dismissal infringed plaintiff's substantial rights; new trial ordered
outcome_on_appeal: Reversed and remanded for new trial

case: Monmouth Medical Center v. State Farm
issue: Appeal from Law Division orders vacating PIP arbitration awards
holding_plain_english: N.J.S.A. 2A:23A-18(b) bars further appeal; appeals dismissed

issue: Whether an ambulatory surgery center can bill PIP for a procedure the fee schedule does not list as reimbursable at an ASC
holding_plain_english: No; discography portion of a 13,582 claim not reimbursable at an ASC

case: Liberty Mutual v. Penske Truck Leasing
issue: Whether a dispute over PIP reimbursement, including whether the other insured was a tortfeasor, must be arbitrated
holding_plain_english: Yes; all issues on the PIP reimbursement claim go to arbitration under N.J.S.A. 39:6A-9.1

issue: Insurer liability for not investigating household health coverage after a health-primary PIP election
holding_plain_english: Insurer immune under N.J.S.A. 17:28-1.9; no duty to investigate

issue: Whether a workers' comp carrier can recover medical and wage benefits from at-fault drivers when the employee fails the permanent-injury threshold
holding_plain_english: Yes; carrier may pursue reimbursement of 33,625 medical and 22,949 wage loss

issue: When the 45-day period to challenge a PIP arbitration award starts
holding_plain_english: From the DRP appeal panel's award, not the initial DRP award; summary action was timely

issue: Whether inter-insurer PIP arbitration must include an in-person hearing
holding_plain_english: No; the Arbitration Act does not require an in-person hearing
